breakdown.description: `ICHARG = 11` freezes the charge density even though the Step 2 note says the HSE run must recompute it and therefore `ICHARG` cannot exceed 10.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification sets ICHARG to 0 for the HSE INCAR file, which is ≤ 10 and thus complies with the requirement that ICHARG cannot exceed 10 when recomputing charge density. This correctly fixes the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt had ICHARG=11, which would have frozen the charge density.
